title: Expense Donut Chart Surrounding Icons & Compact Mobile-Tablet Layout
objective: Transform the Expense Analytics Donut Chart into a clean radial chart with category icons orbiting the circumference slices and minimal text (percentage and total expense only, hiding the bottom legend list), while compacting the overall app UI spacing for mobile and tablet devices.
user_story: As a user checking my expense analytics on mobile/tablet, I want the donut chart to display icons around the ring without the bulky legend below, and I want the entire app layout to be tight and ergonomic.
acceptance_criteria: Donut chart renders category icons along the orbit of each slice with minimal text (% and center total)
Chart legend list below the donut is hidden from view (display: none)
Tabular chart data is hidden from view while preserved for accessibility and test suites
App panels, cards, and KPI grids are tightened for compact mobile and tablet viewports
All 42 automated tests pass with exit code 0
